fields.label: GitLab host
fields.help: GitLab host passed to glab --hostname

fields.label: glab executable
fields.help: glab executable

fields.label: glab timeout
fields.help: Timeout for one glab call

fields.label: Active poll interval
fields.help: Poll interval while you are at the Mac

fields.label: Idle poll interval
fields.help: Poll interval while idle

fields.label: Idle after
fields.help: No keyboard or mouse input for this long counts as idle

fields.label: Maximum backoff
fields.help: Cap for the exponential backoff after failed polls

fields.label: Summary threshold
fields.help: More notifications than this in one poll become one summary

fields.label: Ignored authors
fields.help: GitLab usernames whose comments never alert (for example bots)

fields.label: Teams enabled
fields.help: Switch the Teams flows on

fields.label: Teams MCP command
fields.help: Command that starts the Teams MCP server

fields.label: Teams start timeout
fields.help: Timeout for the Teams MCP to start

fields.label: Teams call timeout
fields.help: Timeout for one Teams MCP call

fields.label: Nudge mode
fields.help: How the nudge flow sends: auto, approval or dry-run

fields.label: Notice mode
fields.help: How the Review Notice flow sends: auto, approval or dry-run

fields.label: Re-review mode
fields.help: How the Re-review Nudge flow sends: auto, approval or dry-run

fields.label: Findings notice mode
fields.help: How the Review Notice with an Agent Review's findings sends: auto, approval or dry-run

fields.label: Approval notice mode
fields.help: How the Review Notice after you approve an MR sends: auto, approval or dry-run. It goes out at the first poll that sees the approval

fields.label: Working hours start
fields.help: Messages only go out inside these hours (Mac local time)

fields.label: Working hours end
fields.help: Messages only go out inside these hours (Mac local time)

fields.label: Working days
fields.help: ISO weekdays, Monday is 1 and Sunday is 7

fields.label: Reminder after
fields.help: Reminder if the Reviewer is still UNREVIEWED this long after the nudge

fields.label: Notice debounce
fields.help: Review Notice after this long without further change by you

fields.label: Re-review after
fields.help: Re-review Nudge after your latest push has stood this long without a newer one

fields.label: Messages per Reviewer
fields.help: At most this many messages per MR per Reviewer

fields.label: Templates folder
fields.help: Folder with template files

fields.label: People
fields.help: GitLab username to email, for people Teams cannot find by name

fields.label: Agent name
fields.help: The name the agent introduces itself with in Teams messages ({{agent.name}})

fields.label: Model CLI
fields.help: Which coding agent CLI runs language model work: auto (the first installed of claude, codex, gemini), claude, codex or gemini

fields.label: Review automatically
fields.help: Review every MR waiting for you that the agent has not reviewed yet, oldest first, and again after a new Review Request; reviews wait in the app until you post them, apart from one the agent approves (review.approve)

fields.label: Posting
fields.help: approval: a ready review waits until you post it, unless the agent approves it (review.approve); auto: it is posted to GitLab as you as soon as it is ready

fields.label: Post as
fields.help: comment: the review is one comment on the MR; inline: each finding that names a line of the reviewed diff becomes a thread on that line, and the rest is one comment. The app asks each time; automatic posting and suica review post use this

fields.label: Approve automatically when ready
fields.help: Approve the MR as you at the reviewed commit, and resolve your threads, once an Agent Review is ready to approve (review.approveWhen). Such a review is posted at once, even with Posting set to approval. Off: approve with one click in the app

fields.label: Ready to approve when
fields.help: What a review may leave and still be ready to approve: minor (only Minor or Nit findings), nit (only Nit findings) or clean (no findings). Open items of a re-review's Previous review section count the same way

fields.label: Ready to approve decided by
fields.help: agent: a second model run reads the review and decides by Ready to approve when and your approval rules, and never approves when it fails; rules: the review's severity headings decide

fields.label: Approval rules
fields.help: Your own rules for the agent that decides, one per line; they win over Ready to approve when. For example: A Major the Author documents as an accepted risk does not hold up approval

fields.label: Review skill
fields.help: Claude Code skill the review follows, picked from the installed ones (plugin:skill in the file). Review with… on an MR picks another one for that review only

fields.label: Review model
fields.help: Model the CLI reviews with, picked from the models it lists, or any other name; CLI default when none is set

fields.label: Review effort
fields.help: How hard the CLI thinks during a review: claude --effort, or Codex reasoning effort (max is xhigh there). Higher levels take longer and use more tokens

fields.label: Largest MR
fields.help: Larger MRs are skipped

fields.label: Automatic reviews per day
fields.help: At most this many automatic reviews in 24 hours; reviews you start yourself do not count

fields.label: Re-review after
fields.help: Re-review an MR after the Author's latest push has stood this long without a newer one

fields.label: Review timeout
fields.help: A review run is stopped after this long

fields.label: Reviews at once
fields.help: How many Agent Reviews run at the same time, 1 to 4, each with its own CLI process and checkout

fields.label: Watch my MRs
fields.help: Answer new Reviewer threads on your own MRs with an Agent Fix until the MR is approved. A fix waits for you: nothing is committed, pushed or replied before you confirm

fields.label: Which MRs to watch
fields.help: all: every MR of yours is watched unless you press Unwatch on it. chosen: only MRs you press Watch on. Fix findings now works on every MR either way

fields.label: Fix failed pipelines
fields.help: With Watch my MRs on, also start an Agent Fix when the head pipeline of one of your MRs fails. It reads the failed jobs' logs and waits for you like any fix

fields.label: Fix model
fields.help: Model the CLI writes fixes with, such as sonnet, opus or haiku for Claude Code, or a full model name; empty uses the CLI's default

fields.label: Fix effort
fields.help: How hard the CLI thinks during a fix: claude --effort, or Codex reasoning effort (max is xhigh there). Higher levels take longer and use more tokens

fields.label: Fix timeout
fields.help: A fix run is stopped after this long

fields.label: Automatic fixes per day
fields.help: At most this many automatic fixes in 24 hours; fixes you start yourself do not count

fields.label: Coding agents to show
fields.help: Which agents the Office looks for on this Mac: claude, codex and gemini

fields.label: More coding agents
fields.help: One per line as name|process|log glob|cwd key|activity key: the program's name, a JSONL log pattern such as ~/.aider/*.jsonl, and the dotted keys of the working folder and the activity in a log line

fields.label: State file
fields.help: SQLite state file
fields.restartNote: A new path starts with an empty history and a fresh baseline.
